description: This file contains a shell script that performs testing of the git diff and diff-tree commands with various pathspec restrictions, including wildcards, submodules, and specific file/directory filters. It sets up test files, runs git commands, and compares expected output to actual results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with a descriptive name.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares the raw diff output to an expected value.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks if the output is empty, indicating no differences.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output for equality.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock, used for timestamping.
